# Progress bar (`progress-bar`)

Determinate or indeterminate, with tones.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createProgressBar` (types in `dist/web/feedback/progress.d.ts`): `.mh-progress`: a determinate or indeterminate bar (`role="progressbar"`). Parts `__header`, `__label`, `__value`, `__track`, `__fill`; modifiers for tone, `--sm | --lg` and `--indeterminate`.

```ts
export function createProgressBar(options: ProgressBarOptions): ProgressBarHandle;

export interface ProgressBarOptions {
  /** Current value; `null` or omitted shows an indeterminate bar. */
  value?: number | null;
  max?: number;
  /** Accessible name (also shown above the bar with `showLabel`). */
  label: string;
  showLabel?: boolean;
  /** Shows the percentage (or `valueText`) above the bar. */
  showValue?: boolean;
  /** Text read and shown for the value, e.g. "3 of 8 rooms". */
  valueText?: string;
  tone?: ProgressTone;
  size?: ProgressSize;
}

export interface ProgressBarHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** `null` switches to indeterminate. */
  setValue(value: number | null, valueText?: string): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createProgressBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const bar = createProgressBar({ label: 'Firmware update', showLabel: true, showValue: true, value: 0 });

const start = createButton({
  label: 'Update',
  icon: 'download',
  onClick: () => {
    start.setDisabled(true);
    let value = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      value += 10;
      bar.setValue(value);
      if (value < 100) return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      start.setDisabled(false);
    }, 400);
  },
});

document.body.append(bar.el, start.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, ProgressBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ProgressBarExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(0);
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false);
  const running = started && value < 100;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => setValue((v) => Math.min(100, v + 10)), 400);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [running]);
  const start = () => {
    setValue(0);
    setStarted(true);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <ProgressBar label="Firmware update" showLabel showValue value={value} />
      <Button icon="download" disabled={running} onClick={start}>
        Update
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}
```
